tables.name: gfn_background_pattern
tables.comment: 导航页背景图案目录及明暗主题默认样式；用户自定义样式另有所有者

columns.name: id
columns.comment: 导航页背景图案目录及明暗主题默认样式的行身份；用于稳定引用该记录

columns.name: name
columns.comment: 运营识别该素材的中文名称

columns.name: name_en
columns.comment: 运营识别该素材的英文名称

columns.name: object_key
columns.comment: Managed Asset 图案对象键，形如 nav/patterns/哈希.svg；不保存 CDN 域名

columns.name: light_color
columns.comment: 浅色主题的默认图案颜色，十六进制颜色值

columns.name: dark_color
columns.comment: 深色主题的默认图案颜色，十六进制颜色值

columns.name: light_opacity
columns.comment: 浅色主题的默认图案不透明度，范围 0..1

columns.name: dark_opacity
columns.comment: 深色主题的默认图案不透明度，范围 0..1

columns.name: default_size_px
columns.comment: 默认图案平铺尺寸，单位像素

columns.name: enabled
columns.comment: 是否允许该素材参与公开展示；删除状态另行约束

columns.name: sort_order
columns.comment: 背景图案选项的展示顺序

columns.name: deleted
columns.comment: 是否已软删除；不代表已删除云端对象

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.comment: 素材软删除的 UTC 时刻；未删除时为 NULL

columns.name: create_time
columns.comment: 导航页背景图案目录及明暗主题默认样式的记录创建时间

columns.name: update_time
columns.comment: 导航页背景图案目录及明暗主题默认样式的记录最近更新时间

indexes.name: gfn_background_pattern_catalog_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX gfn_background_pattern_catalog_idx ON public.gfn_background_pattern USING btree (sort_order, id) WHERE (enabled AND (NOT deleted))

tables.name: gfn_change_checkpoints
tables.comment: 网站变化检测器各版本的独立有序水位；与事件投影原子提交

columns.name: detector_key
columns.comment: 变化检测器的稳定标识，与 detector_version 共同定位合同

columns.name: detector_version
columns.comment: 变化检测语义版本；各版本独立投影和推进水位

columns.name: source_start_date
columns.comment: 可重建源证据的首个 UTC 日期；NULL 表示尚无起始证据

columns.name: processed_through
columns.comment: 已连续处理完成的最后一个 UTC 日期；NULL 表示尚未完成任何一天

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: 网站变化检测器各版本的独立有序水位的记录创建时间

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: 网站变化检测器各版本的独立有序水位的记录最近更新时间

constraints.name: fk_gfn_change_checkpoint_registry
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (detector_key, detector_version) REFERENCES gfn_change_registry(detector_key, detector_version) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: gfn_change_checkpoint_range_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (source_start_date IS NULL OR processed_through IS NULL OR processed_through >= source_start_date)

tables.name: gfn_change_events
tables.comment: 网站规范变化事件；确定性身份，来源仅为历史合同，不外键依赖当前目录

columns.name: event_key
columns.comment: 规范事件的确定性文本身份；相同来源重建得到相同键

columns.name: detector_key
columns.comment: 变化检测器的稳定标识，与 detector_version 共同定位合同

columns.name: detector_version
columns.comment: 变化检测语义版本；各版本独立投影和推进水位

columns.name: site_id
columns.comment: GoFurry 网站身份；与探测目标域名分别保存

columns.name: projection_date
columns.comment: 事件被投影到的 UTC 日期，用于按日原子替换重建

columns.name: event_at
columns.comment: 明确的生效或观察时刻；只有日粒度证据时为 NULL，不能伪造精确时间

columns.name: time_basis
columns.comment: 事件时间依据 effective、observed 或 day；day 不携带 event_at

columns.name: event_code
columns.comment: 检测器合同定义的业务变化类型

columns.name: scope_kind
columns.comment: 事件作用范围类型，用于区分实体、地区或历史目标等范围

columns.name: scope_key
columns.comment: 事件在该作用范围内的稳定身份，不跨历史跟踪区间合并变化

columns.name: old_value
columns.comment: 变化前的已知语义值 JSON 对象，不使用失败噪声覆盖已知值

columns.name: new_value
columns.comment: 变化后的已知语义值 JSON 对象

columns.name: source_event_key
columns.comment: 来源事件确定性身份，与检测器及版本联合唯一以防重复产出

columns.name: source_before_key
columns.comment: 支持变化前语义的规范源证据键

columns.name: source_after_key
columns.comment: 支持变化后语义的规范源证据键

columns.name: source_before_at
columns.comment: 变化前证据时刻；只有日粒度或无精确时刻时为 NULL

columns.name: source_after_at
columns.comment: 变化后证据时刻；只有日粒度或无精确时刻时为 NULL

columns.name: source_versions
columns.comment: 该事件依赖的事实、指标或源合同版本 JSON 对象

columns.name: materialized_at
columns.comment: 规范事件最近一次物化的 UTC 时刻，不是业务变化发生时刻

constraints.name: fk_gfn_change_event_registry
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (detector_key, detector_version) REFERENCES gfn_change_registry(detector_key, detector_version) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: gfn_change_event_text_shape_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (btrim(event_key) <> ''::text AND btrim(event_code) <> ''::text AND btrim(scope_kind) <> ''::text AND btrim(scope_key) <> ''::text AND btrim(source_event_key) <> ''::text AND btrim(source_before_key) <> ''::text AND btrim(source_after_key) <> ''::text)

constraints.name: gfn_change_event_time_shape_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((time_basis = ANY (ARRAY['effective'::text, 'observed'::text])) AND event_at IS NOT NULL OR time_basis = 'day'::text AND event_at IS NULL)

indexes.name: idx_gfn_change_events_code_date
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_gfn_change_events_code_date ON public.gfn_change_events USING btree (event_code, projection_date DESC)

indexes.name: idx_gfn_change_events_detector_date
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_gfn_change_events_detector_date ON public.gfn_change_events USING btree (detector_key, detector_version, projection_date DESC)

indexes.name: idx_gfn_change_events_event_at
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_gfn_change_events_event_at ON public.gfn_change_events USING btree (event_at DESC) WHERE (event_at IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_gfn_change_events_scope_date
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_gfn_change_events_scope_date ON public.gfn_change_events USING btree (scope_kind, scope_key, projection_date DESC)

indexes.name: idx_gfn_change_events_site_date
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_gfn_change_events_site_date ON public.gfn_change_events USING btree (site_id, projection_date DESC)

tables.name: gfn_change_registry
tables.comment: 网站变化检测器版本注册合同；仅 Goose 修改，历史版本语义不可覆盖

columns.name: detector_key
columns.comment: 变化检测器的稳定标识，与 detector_version 共同定位合同

columns.name: detector_version
columns.comment: 变化检测语义版本；各版本独立投影和推进水位

columns.name: source_kind
columns.comment: 源证据类型 metric、fact、domain_history 或 effective_period

columns.name: source_contracts
columns.comment: 检测器依赖的规范源合同列表；不得以原始采集或当前目录替代

columns.name: detection_policy
columns.comment: 定义语义变化判定的编译策略标识

columns.name: watermark_policy
columns.comment: 定义可处理历史范围和源水位依赖的编译策略标识

columns.name: event_codes
columns.comment: 该检测器版本可产出的规范事件类型列表

columns.name: processing_grain
columns.comment: 处理粒度；当前固定为 day，即 UTC 日

columns.name: status
columns.comment: 合同状态 active 或 retired；历史版本保留明确的重建语义

columns.name: description
columns.comment: 检测器版本的业务含义和证据口径说明

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: 网站变化检测器版本注册合同的记录创建时间

columns.name: retired_at
columns.comment: 检测器退休的 UTC 时刻；active 时为 NULL

constraints.name: gfn_change_registry_status_shape_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status = 'active'::text AND retired_at IS NULL OR status = 'retired'::text AND retired_at IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: uq_gfn_change_registry_active_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_gfn_change_registry_active_key ON public.gfn_change_registry USING btree (detector_key) WHERE (status = 'active'::text)

tables.name: gfn_collection_jobs
tables.comment: 网站采集持久任务；计划槽与活跃去重键保证幂等，租约由 PostgreSQL 持有

columns.name: id
columns.comment: 网站采集持久任务的行身份；用于稳定引用该记录

columns.name: schedule_id
columns.comment: 来源调度身份；非计划来源可为 NULL，调度删除后保留任务并置空

columns.name: schedule_version
columns.comment: 任务建立时的调度版本；无调度来源时为 NULL

columns.name: job_key
columns.comment: 编译期采集能力的稳定标识；用于匹配执行器与调度合同

columns.name: trigger
columns.comment: 触发来源 scheduled、manual、startup_catchup、entity_created、entity_changed

columns.name: scope_type
columns.comment: 执行范围：all 全量或 site 单实体，target 指定探测目标

columns.name: scope_id
columns.comment: 单实体范围的 网站身份；全量范围为 NULL

columns.name: target
columns.comment: 指定探测目标范围的地址；非 target 范围为 NULL

columns.name: tasks
columns.comment: 本任务请求执行的采集能力列表，不能为空

columns.name: priority
columns.comment: 进入执行队列的优先级，由创建任务时的调度或请求确定

columns.name: concurrency_key
columns.comment: 采集并发通道标识；同一通道最多一个运行中的 Job

columns.name: scheduled_for
columns.comment: 计划槽的 UTC 时刻；手动触发没有计划槽，为 NULL

columns.name: status
columns.comment: 任务状态 queued、running、success、partial、failed、skipped、missed 或 canceled

columns.name: requested_by
columns.comment: 请求创建任务的操作者或系统来源标识

columns.name: dedupe_key
columns.comment: 活跃任务去重键；无需去重时为 NULL

columns.name: claimed_by
columns.comment: 持有执行租约的采集实例身份；未领取时为 NULL

columns.name: lease_until
columns.comment: 执行租约的 UTC 到期时刻；用于故障后回收，不是计划时间

columns.name: cancel_requested_at
columns.comment: 请求取消的 UTC 时刻；NULL 表示没有取消请求

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: 网站采集持久任务的记录创建时间

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: 网站采集持久任务的记录最近更新时间

columns.name: completed_at
columns.comment: 任务进入终态的 UTC 时刻；尚未结束时为 NULL

constraints.name: gfn_collection_jobs_claim_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status = 'running'::text AND claimed_by IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL OR status <> 'running'::text)

constraints.name: gfn_collection_jobs_schedule_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (trigger <> 'scheduled'::text OR schedule_id IS NOT NULL AND schedule_version IS NOT NULL AND scheduled_for IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: gfn_collection_jobs_schedule_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (schedule_id) REFERENCES gfn_collection_schedules(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: gfn_collection_jobs_scope_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (scope_type = 'all'::text AND scope_id IS NULL AND target IS NULL OR scope_type = 'site'::text AND scope_id IS NOT NULL AND target IS NULL OR scope_type = 'target'::text AND scope_id IS NOT NULL AND target IS NOT NULL AND btrim(target) <> ''::text)

indexes.name: idx_gfn_collection_jobs_claim
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_gfn_collection_jobs_claim ON public.gfn_collection_jobs USING btree (status, priority DESC, created_at, id)

indexes.name: idx_gfn_collection_jobs_key_time
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_gfn_collection_jobs_key_time ON public.gfn_collection_jobs USING btree (job_key, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: idx_gfn_collection_jobs_lane
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_gfn_collection_jobs_lane ON public.gfn_collection_jobs USING btree (concurrency_key, status)

indexes.name: idx_gfn_collection_jobs_schedule_slot
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_gfn_collection_jobs_schedule_slot ON public.gfn_collection_jobs USING btree (schedule_id, scheduled_for)

indexes.name: uq_gfn_collection_jobs_active_dedupe
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_gfn_collection_jobs_active_dedupe ON public.gfn_collection_jobs USING btree (dedupe_key) WHERE ((dedupe_key IS NOT NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'running'::text])))

indexes.name: uq_gfn_collection_jobs_running_lane
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_gfn_collection_jobs_running_lane ON public.gfn_collection_jobs USING btree (concurrency_key) WHERE (status = 'running'::text)

indexes.name: uq_gfn_collection_jobs_scheduled_slot
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_gfn_collection_jobs_scheduled_slot ON public.gfn_collection_jobs USING btree (schedule_id, scheduled_for) WHERE ((schedule_id IS NOT NULL) AND (scheduled_for IS NOT NULL))

tables.name: gfn_collection_runs
tables.comment: 网站采集任务的执行尝试账本；同一 Job 可有多个递增尝试

columns.name: id
columns.comment: 本次执行尝试的文本身份，用于关联原始观察及任务结果

columns.name: job_id
columns.comment: 所属持久采集任务身份，删除任务时级联删除执行记录

columns.name: attempt_no
columns.comment: 同一 Job 内从 1 开始的尝试序号，与 job_id 联合唯一

columns.name: collector_instance_id
columns.comment: 执行本次尝试的采集进程实例身份

columns.name: status
columns.comment: 尝试状态 running、success、partial、failed 或 canceled

columns.name: scheduled_for
columns.comment: 计划槽的 UTC 时刻；手动触发没有计划槽，为 NULL

columns.name: started_at
columns.comment: 本次执行尝试实际开始的 UTC 时刻

columns.name: ended_at
columns.comment: 本次执行尝试结束的 UTC 时刻；运行中为 NULL

columns.name: expected_count
columns.comment: 本次执行计划处理的实体任务数

columns.name: attempted_count
columns.comment: 已尝试的实体任务数，等于 success_count + partial_count + failure_count

columns.name: success_count
columns.comment: 本次尝试中完整成功的实体任务数

columns.name: partial_count
columns.comment: 本次尝试中部分成功的实体任务数

columns.name: failure_count
columns.comment: 本次尝试中失败的实体任务数

columns.name: skipped_count
columns.comment: 本次尝试中未执行而跳过的实体任务数

columns.name: schedule_delay_ms
columns.comment: 相对计划槽的启动延迟，单位毫秒且不为负

columns.name: duration_ms
columns.comment: 本次执行耗时，单位毫秒

columns.name: error_kind
columns.comment: 采集失败的稳定分类；无分类时为空串

columns.name: error_message
columns.comment: 采集失败的诊断摘要；无错误时为空串

constraints.name: gfn_collection_runs_job_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES gfn_collection_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.name: idx_gfn_collection_runs_instance_time
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_gfn_collection_runs_instance_time ON public.gfn_collection_runs USING btree (collector_instance_id, started_at DESC)

indexes.name: idx_gfn_collection_runs_job_time
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_gfn_collection_runs_job_time ON public.gfn_collection_runs USING btree (job_id, started_at DESC)

indexes.name: idx_gfn_collection_runs_scheduled_for
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_gfn_collection_runs_scheduled_for ON public.gfn_collection_runs USING btree (scheduled_for)

indexes.name: idx_gfn_collection_runs_status_time
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_gfn_collection_runs_status_time ON public.gfn_collection_runs USING btree (status, started_at DESC)

tables.name: gfn_collection_schedules
tables.comment: 网站采集的持久调度定义；PostgreSQL 为计划及槽位的权威来源

columns.name: id
columns.comment: 网站采集的持久调度定义的行身份；用于稳定引用该记录

columns.name: job_key
columns.comment: 编译期采集能力的稳定标识；用于匹配执行器与调度合同

columns.name: name
columns.comment: 供运营识别的调度名称

columns.name: enabled
columns.comment: 是否允许调度器为此计划物化新的 Job

columns.name: schedule_kind
columns.comment: 调度方式 cron 或 interval，决定相应参数组

columns.name: cron_expression
columns.comment: cron 调度表达式；interval 模式为 NULL

columns.name: interval_seconds
columns.comment: 固定调度间隔，单位秒且大于零；cron 模式为 NULL

columns.name: anchor_at
columns.comment: interval 计划的 UTC 相位锚点；cron 模式为 NULL

columns.name: timezone
columns.comment: 解释 cron 表达式所用的时区名称

columns.name: misfire_policy
columns.comment: 错过槽位的处理策略：skip 跳过或 catch_up_once 补一次

columns.name: misfire_grace_seconds
columns.comment: 允许迟到执行的宽限秒数

columns.name: overlap_policy
columns.comment: 同通道重叠时的策略；当前合同仅允许 skip

columns.name: priority
columns.comment: Job 排队优先级；用于执行调度而非内容展示

columns.name: concurrency_key
columns.comment: 采集并发通道标识；同一通道最多一个运行中的 Job

columns.name: version
columns.comment: 乐观并发版本；修改时必须匹配旧版本并递增

columns.name: effective_from
columns.comment: 该版本调度定义开始生效的 UTC 时刻

columns.name: last_materialized_for
columns.comment: 最后已物化的计划槽时刻；尚无槽位时为 NULL

columns.name: next_scheduled_for
columns.comment: 下一个计划槽的 UTC 时刻；不可计算时为 NULL

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: 网站采集的持久调度定义的记录创建时间

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: 网站采集的持久调度定义的记录最近更新时间

constraints.name: gfn_collection_schedules_shape_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (schedule_kind = 'cron'::text AND cron_expression IS NOT NULL AND btrim(cron_expression) <> ''::text AND interval_seconds IS NULL AND anchor_at IS NULL OR schedule_kind = 'interval'::text AND cron_expression IS NULL AND interval_seconds > 0 AND anchor_at IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_gfn_collection_schedules_due
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_gfn_collection_schedules_due ON public.gfn_collection_schedules USING btree (enabled, next_scheduled_for)

tables.name: gfn_collection_task_results
tables.comment: 网站采集执行中每个实体与能力的结果；与 Run 共同形成质量账本

columns.name: id
columns.comment: 网站采集执行中每个实体与能力的结果的行身份；用于稳定引用该记录

columns.name: run_id
columns.comment: 所属执行尝试的文本身份，引用 collection_runs

columns.name: protocol
columns.comment: 本项执行的探测协议，与 Nav 采集能力合同一致

columns.name: site_id
columns.comment: GoFurry 网站身份；与探测目标域名分别保存

columns.name: target
columns.comment: 本项执行的探测地址，与网站身份分别保存

columns.name: status
columns.comment: 单项结果 success、partial、failed 或 skipped

columns.name: observation_id
columns.comment: 产生的原始观察身份；未产生或原始观察已裁剪时为 NULL

columns.name: duration_ms
columns.comment: 本次执行耗时，单位毫秒

columns.name: error_kind
columns.comment: 采集失败的稳定分类；无分类时为空串

columns.name: error_message
columns.comment: 采集失败的诊断摘要；无错误时为空串

columns.name: started_at
columns.comment: 本项能力开始执行的 UTC 时刻

columns.name: ended_at
columns.comment: 本项能力执行结束的 UTC 时刻；未记录时为 NULL

constraints.name: gfn_collection_task_results_observation_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (observation_id) REFERENCES gfn_collector_observation(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: gfn_collection_task_results_run_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES gfn_collection_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.name: idx_gfn_collection_task_results_protocol_time

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gfn_project_change_day(target_detector_key text, target_detector_version integer, target_date date)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    inserted_rows bigint := 0;
    source_metric_key text;
BEGIN
    IF target_detector_version <> 1 OR target_detector_key NOT IN (
        'ipv6_transition', 'tls13_transition', 'security_txt_transition',
        'primary_target_transition', 'tls_certificate_transition'
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nav change detector is not compiled for %/%', target_detector_key, target_detector_version;
    END IF;

    DELETE FROM public.gfn_change_events
    WHERE detector_key = target_detector_key
      AND detector_version = target_detector_version
      AND projection_date = target_date;

    IF target_detector_key IN ('ipv6_transition', 'tls13_transition', 'security_txt_transition') THEN
        source_metric_key := CASE target_detector_key
            WHEN 'ipv6_transition' THEN 'ipv6_adoption'
            WHEN 'tls13_transition' THEN 'tls13_adoption'
            WHEN 'security_txt_transition' THEN 'security_txt_adoption'
        END;

        INSERT INTO public.gfn_change_events (
            event_key, detector_key, detector_version, site_id, projection_date,
            event_at, time_basis, event_code, scope_kind, scope_key,
            old_value, new_value, source_event_key, source_before_key, source_after_key,
            source_before_at, source_after_at, source_versions, materialized_at
        )
        SELECT target_detector_key || '/1/' || event_identity.source_event_key,
               target_detector_key, 1, current_metric.site_id, target_date,
               current_metric.source_observed_at,
               CASE WHEN current_metric.source_observed_at IS NULL THEN 'day' ELSE 'observed' END,
               CASE target_detector_key
                   WHEN 'ipv6_transition' THEN CASE WHEN current_metric.state = 'positive' THEN 'ipv6_enabled' ELSE 'ipv6_disabled' END
                   WHEN 'tls13_transition' THEN CASE WHEN current_metric.state = 'positive' THEN 'tls13_enabled' ELSE 'tls13_disabled' END
                   WHEN 'security_txt_transition' THEN CASE WHEN current_metric.state = 'positive' THEN 'security_txt_added' ELSE 'security_txt_removed' END
               END,
               'global', 'all',
               jsonb_build_object('state', previous_metric.state, 'reason_code', previous_metric.reason_code),
               jsonb_build_object('state', current_metric.state, 'reason_code', current_metric.reason_code),
               event_identity.source_event_key,
               source_metric_key || '/1/' || previous_metric.fact_date || '/' || current_metric.site_id,
               source_metric_key || '/1/' || current_metric.fact_date || '/' || current_metric.site_id,
               previous_metric.source_observed_at, current_metric.source_observed_at,
               jsonb_build_object(
                   'metric_key', source_metric_key, 'metric_version', 1,
                   'before_fact_projection_versions', previous_metric.source_projection_versions,
                   'after_fact_projection_versions', current_metric.source_projection_versions,
                   'primary_target_tracking_period_id', current_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id
               ),
               transaction_timestamp()
        FROM public.gfn_metric_entity_daily current_metric
        JOIN public.gfn_site_daily current_fact
          ON current_fact.site_id = current_metric.site_id
         AND current_fact.fact_date = current_metric.fact_date
         AND current_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
        JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT previous_metric.*
            FROM public.gfn_metric_entity_daily previous_metric
            JOIN public.gfn_site_daily previous_fact
              ON previous_fact.site_id = previous_metric.site_id
             AND previous_fact.fact_date = previous_metric.fact_date
             AND previous_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
            WHERE previous_metric.metric_key = current_metric.metric_key
              AND previous_metric.metric_version = current_metric.metric_version
              AND previous_metric.site_id = current_metric.site_id
              AND previous_metric.fact_date < current_metric.fact_date
              AND previous_metric.state IN ('positive', 'negative')
              AND previous_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id = current_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id
            ORDER BY previous_metric.fact_date DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) previous_metric ON true
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT source_metric_key || '/1/' || current_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id || '/'
                   || current_metric.site_id || '/' || previous_metric.fact_date || '/' || current_metric.fact_date AS source_event_key
        ) event_identity
        WHERE current_metric.metric_key = source_metric_key
          AND current_metric.metric_version = 1
          AND current_metric.fact_date = target_date
          AND current_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id IS NOT NULL
          AND current_metric.state IN ('positive', 'negative')
          AND current_metric.state <> previous_metric.state;

    ELSIF target_detector_key = 'primary_target_transition' THEN
        INSERT INTO public.gfn_change_events (
            event_key, detector_key, detector_version, site_id, projection_date,
            event_at, time_basis, event_code, scope_kind, scope_key,
            old_value, new_value, source_event_key, source_before_key, source_after_key,
            source_before_at, source_after_at, source_versions, materialized_at
        )
        SELECT 'primary_target_transition/1/period/' || current_period.id,
               target_detector_key, 1, current_period.site_id, target_date,
               current_period.effective_from, 'effective', 'primary_target_changed', 'global', 'all',
               jsonb_build_object('target_tracking_period_id', previous_period.target_tracking_period_id,
                                  'target', previous_target.target, 'basis', previous_period.basis),
               jsonb_build_object('target_tracking_period_id', current_period.target_tracking_period_id,
                                  'target', current_target.target, 'basis', current_period.basis),
               'period/' || current_period.id, 'period/' || previous_period.id, 'period/' || current_period.id,
               previous_period.effective_from, current_period.effective_from,
               jsonb_build_object('period_contract', 1), transaction_timestamp()
        FROM public.gfn_site_primary_target_periods current_period
        JOIN public.gfn_site_primary_target_periods previous_period
          ON previous_period.site_id = current_period.site_id
         AND previous_period.effective_until = current_period.effective_from
        JOIN public.gfn_target_tracking_periods previous_target
          ON previous_target.id = previous_period.target_tracking_period_id
        JOIN public.gfn_target_tracking_periods current_target
          ON current_target.id = current_period.target_tracking_period_id
        WHERE (current_period.effective_from AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date = target_date
          AND previous_period.target_tracking_period_id <> current_period.target_tracking_period_id;

    ELSE
        WITH current_certificate AS (
            SELECT fact.*
            FROM public.gfn_site_target_daily fact
            WHERE fact.fact_date = target_date
              AND fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
              AND NULLIF(btrim(fact.tls_cert_fingerprint_sha256), '') IS NOT NULL
        ), paired AS (
            SELECT current_certificate.*,
                   previous.fact_date AS before_date,
                   previous.tls_state_observed_at AS before_observed_at,
                   previous.tls_cert_fingerprint_sha256 AS before_fingerprint,
                   previous.tls_cert_spki_sha256 AS before_spki,
                   previous.tls_cert_issuer AS before_issuer,
                   previous.tls_cert_not_before AS before_not_before,
                   previous.tls_cert_not_after AS before_not_after,
                   previous.tls_cert_verified AS before_verified,
                   previous.projection_version AS before_projection_version
            FROM current_certificate
            JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT candidate.*
                FROM public.gfn_site_target_daily candidate
                WHERE candidate.target_tracking_period_id = current_certificate.target_tracking_period_id
                  AND candidate.fact_date < current_certificate.fact_date
                  AND candidate.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
                  AND NULLIF(btrim(candidate.tls_cert_fingerprint_sha256), '') IS NOT NULL
                ORDER BY candidate.fact_date DESC
                LIMIT 1
            ) previous ON true
        )
        INSERT INTO public.gfn_change_events (
            event_key, detector_key, detector_version, site_id, projection_date,
            event_at, time_basis, event_code, scope_kind, scope_key,
            old_value, new_value, source_event_key, source_before_key, source_after_key,
            source_before_at, source_after_at, source_versions, materialized_at
        )
        SELECT 'tls_certificate_transition/1/' || target_tracking_period_id || '/' || fact_date,
               target_detector_key, 1, site_id, target_date,
               tls_state_observed_at,
               CASE WHEN tls_state_observed_at IS NULL THEN 'day' ELSE 'observed' END,
               'tls_certificate_changed', 'target', target_tracking_period_id::text,
               jsonb_build_object('fingerprint_sha256', before_fingerprint, 'spki_sha256', before_spki,
                                  'issuer', before_issuer, 'not_before', before_not_before,
                                  'not_after', before_not_after, 'verified', before_verified),
               jsonb_build_object('fingerprint_sha256', tls_cert_fingerprint_sha256,
                                  'spki_sha256', tls_cert_spki_sha256, 'issuer', tls_cert_issuer,
                                  'not_before', tls_cert_not_before, 'not_after', tls_cert_not_after,
                                  'verified', tls_cert_verified),
               target_tracking_period_id || '/' || fact_date,
               'certificate/' || target_tracking_period_id || '/' || before_date,
               'certificate/' || target_tracking_period_id || '/' || fact_date,
               before_observed_at, tls_state_observed_at,
               jsonb_build_object('before_projection_version', before_projection_version,
                                  'after_projection_version', projection_version,
                                  'target_tracking_period_id', target_tracking_period_id),
               transaction_timestamp()
        FROM paired
        WHERE before_fingerprint <> tls_cert_fingerprint_sha256;
    END IF;

    GET DIAGNOSTICS inserted_rows = ROW_COUNT;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.gfn_change_events event
        JOIN public.gfn_change_registry registry
          ON registry.detector_key = event.detector_key
         AND registry.detector_version = event.detector_version
        WHERE event.detector_key = target_detector_key
          AND event.detector_version = target_detector_version
          AND event.projection_date = target_date
          AND NOT (event.event_code = ANY(registry.event_codes))
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nav change detector emitted an undeclared event code for %/% on %',
            target_detector_key, target_detector_version, target_date;
    END IF;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.gfn_change_events
        WHERE detector_key = target_detector_key AND detector_version = target_detector_version
          AND projection_date = target_date AND time_basis = 'observed'
          AND event_at IS DISTINCT FROM source_after_at
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nav observed change event timestamp differs from source_after_at for %/% on %',
            target_detector_key, target_detector_version, target_date;
    END IF;

    RETURN inserted_rows;
END;
$function$
functions.comment: 按检测器及版本重建指定 UTC 日的 V1 网站规范变化事件；保留历史语义记忆及主目标区间边界，返回写入条数

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gfn_project_change_day_v2(target_detector_key text, target_detector_version integer, target_date date)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    inserted_rows bigint := 0;
    source_metric_key text;
BEGIN
    IF target_detector_version <> 2
       OR target_detector_key NOT IN ('ipv6_transition', 'security_txt_transition') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nav change v2 detector is not compiled for %/%', target_detector_key, target_detector_version;
    END IF;

    source_metric_key := CASE target_detector_key
        WHEN 'ipv6_transition' THEN 'ipv6_adoption'
        WHEN 'security_txt_transition' THEN 'security_txt_adoption'
    END;

    DELETE FROM public.gfn_change_events
    WHERE detector_key = target_detector_key
      AND detector_version = target_detector_version
      AND projection_date = target_date;

    INSERT INTO public.gfn_change_events (
        event_key, detector_key, detector_version, site_id, projection_date,
        event_at, time_basis, event_code, scope_kind, scope_key,
        old_value, new_value, source_event_key, source_before_key, source_after_key,
        source_before_at, source_after_at, source_versions, materialized_at
    )
    SELECT target_detector_key || '/2/' || event_identity.source_event_key,
           target_detector_key, 2, current_metric.site_id, target_date,
           current_metric.source_observed_at,
           CASE WHEN current_metric.source_observed_at IS NULL THEN 'day' ELSE 'observed' END,
           CASE target_detector_key
               WHEN 'ipv6_transition' THEN CASE WHEN current_metric.state = 'positive' THEN 'ipv6_enabled' ELSE 'ipv6_disabled' END
               WHEN 'security_txt_transition' THEN CASE WHEN current_metric.state = 'positive' THEN 'security_txt_added' ELSE 'security_txt_removed' END
           END,
           'global', 'all',
           jsonb_build_object('state', previous_metric.state, 'reason_code', previous_metric.reason_code),
           jsonb_build_object('state', current_metric.state, 'reason_code', current_metric.reason_code),
           event_identity.source_event_key,
           source_metric_key || '/2/' || previous_metric.fact_date || '/' || current_metric.site_id,
           source_metric_key || '/2/' || current_metric.fact_date || '/' || current_metric.site_id,
           previous_metric.source_observed_at, current_metric.source_observed_at,
           jsonb_build_object(
               'metric_key', source_metric_key, 'metric_version', 2,
               'before_fact_projection_versions', previous_metric.source_projection_versions,
               'after_fact_projection_versions', current_metric.source_projection_versions,
               'primary_target_tracking_period_id', current_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id
           ),
           transaction_timestamp()
    FROM public.gfn_metric_entity_daily current_metric
    JOIN public.gfn_site_daily current_fact
      ON current_fact.site_id = current_metric.site_id
     AND current_fact.fact_date = current_metric.fact_date
     AND current_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT previous_metric.*
        FROM public.gfn_metric_entity_daily previous_metric
        JOIN public.gfn_site_daily previous_fact
          ON previous_fact.site_id = previous_metric.site_id
         AND previous_fact.fact_date = previous_metric.fact_date
         AND previous_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
        WHERE previous_metric.metric_key = current_metric.metric_key
          AND previous_metric.metric_version = current_metric.metric_version
          AND previous_metric.site_id = current_metric.site_id
          AND previous_metric.fact_date < current_metric.fact_date
          AND previous_metric.state IN ('positive', 'negative')
          AND previous_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id = current_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id
        ORDER BY previous_metric.fact_date DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) previous_metric ON true
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT source_metric_key || '/2/' || current_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id || '/'
               || current_metric.site_id || '/' || previous_metric.fact_date || '/' || current_metric.fact_date AS source_event_key
    ) event_identity
    WHERE current_metric.metric_key = source_metric_key
      AND current_metric.metric_version = 2
      AND current_metric.fact_date = target_date
      AND current_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id IS NOT NULL
      AND current_metric.state IN ('positive', 'negative')
      AND current_metric.state <> previous_metric.state;

    GET DIAGNOSTICS inserted_rows = ROW_COUNT;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.gfn_change_events event
        JOIN public.gfn_change_registry registry
          ON registry.detector_key = event.detector_key
         AND registry.detector_version = event.detector_version
        WHERE event.detector_key = target_detector_key
          AND event.detector_version = target_detector_version
          AND event.projection_date = target_date
          AND NOT (event.event_code = ANY(registry.event_codes))
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nav change detector emitted an undeclared event code for %/% on %',
            target_detector_key, target_detector_version, target_date;
    END IF;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.gfn_change_events
        WHERE detector_key = target_detector_key AND detector_version = target_detector_version
          AND projection_date = target_date AND time_basis = 'observed'
          AND event_at IS DISTINCT FROM source_after_at
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nav observed change event timestamp differs from source_after_at for %/% on %',
            target_detector_key, target_detector_version, target_date;
    END IF;

    RETURN inserted_rows;
END;
$function$
functions.comment: 重建指定 UTC 日的 V2 IPv6 或 security.txt 变化事件，严格使用 V2 证据合同；返回写入条数，不覆盖 V1 历史语义

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gfn_project_http2_metric_day_v2(target_metric_key text, target_metric_version integer, target_date date)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    day_end timestamp with time zone := (target_date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
    freshness bigint;
    cutover_start date;
    entity_rows bigint;
BEGIN
    IF target_metric_key IS DISTINCT FROM 'http2_adoption'
       OR target_metric_version IS DISTINCT FROM 2 OR target_date IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nav HTTP/2 v2 evaluator is not compiled for %/% on %',
            target_metric_key, target_metric_version, target_date;
    END IF;

    SELECT registry.freshness_seconds, checkpoint.source_start_date
    INTO freshness, cutover_start
    FROM public.gfn_metric_registry registry
    JOIN public.gfn_metric_checkpoints checkpoint USING (metric_key, metric_version)
    WHERE registry.metric_key = target_metric_key AND registry.metric_version = target_metric_version;
    IF NOT FOUND OR cutover_start IS NULL OR target_date < cutover_start THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nav HTTP/2 v2 day is before or lacks source_start_date: %', target_date;
    END IF;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.gfn_site_daily site_fact
        JOIN public.gfn_site_target_protocol_daily protocol_fact
          ON protocol_fact.target_tracking_period_id = site_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id
         AND protocol_fact.site_id = site_fact.site_id
         AND protocol_fact.fact_date = site_fact.fact_date
         AND protocol_fact.protocol = 'http'
         AND protocol_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
        WHERE site_fact.fact_date = target_date
          AND site_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND site_fact.tracked_at_end
          AND protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at > day_end
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nav HTTP/2 source evidence is after UTC day end on %', target_date;
    END IF;

    DELETE FROM public.gfn_metric_entity_daily
    WHERE metric_key = target_metric_key AND metric_version = target_metric_version AND fact_date = target_date;
    DELETE FROM public.gfn_metric_daily
    WHERE metric_key = target_metric_key AND metric_version = target_metric_version AND fact_date = target_date;

    WITH evidence AS (
        SELECT site_fact.*,
               target_fact.projection_version AS target_version,
               protocol_fact.projection_version AS protocol_version,
               protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at AS observed_at,
               protocol_fact.known_state AS payload,
               protocol_fact.quality_basis, protocol_fact.attempted_count, protocol_fact.success_count
        FROM public.gfn_site_daily site_fact
        LEFT JOIN public.gfn_site_target_daily target_fact
          ON target_fact.target_tracking_period_id = site_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id
         AND target_fact.site_id = site_fact.site_id AND target_fact.fact_date = site_fact.fact_date
         AND target_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
        LEFT JOIN public.gfn_site_target_protocol_daily protocol_fact
          ON protocol_fact.target_tracking_period_id = site_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id
         AND protocol_fact.site_id = site_fact.site_id AND protocol_fact.fact_date = site_fact.fact_date
         AND protocol_fact.protocol = 'http' AND protocol_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
        WHERE site_fact.fact_date = target_date AND site_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
          AND site_fact.tracked_at_end
    ), reasons AS (
        SELECT evidence.*,
               CASE
                   WHEN primary_target_tracking_period_id IS NULL THEN 'primary_target_unknown'
                   WHEN observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND observed_at < day_end - make_interval(secs => freshness::double precision)
                       THEN 'http_state_stale'
                   WHEN observed_at IS NULL THEN CASE
                       WHEN quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger' AND attempted_count > 0 AND success_count = 0
                           THEN 'http_probe_failed'
                       WHEN quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger' AND attempted_count = 0
                           THEN 'http_not_probed'
                       ELSE 'historical_probe_state_unknown'
                   END
                   WHEN target_version IS NULL THEN 'primary_target_fact_unknown'
                   WHEN payload ->> 'http2_probe_profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'go_h2_enabled_v1'
                       THEN 'http2_probe_profile_unknown'
                   WHEN jsonb_typeof(payload -> 'final_url') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
                     OR jsonb_typeof(payload -> 'final_scheme') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
                     OR jsonb_typeof(payload -> 'http_protocol') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
                     OR jsonb_typeof(payload -> 'tls_alpn') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
                     OR COALESCE(payload ->> 'http_protocol', '') = ''
                       THEN 'http2_evidence_incomplete'
                   -- Require an absolute final endpoint and agreement with its derived scheme.
                   WHEN (payload ->> 'final_url') !~ '^https?://[^/?#[:space:]]+([/?#][^[:space:]]*)?$'
                     OR split_part(payload ->> 'final_url', ':', 1) IS DISTINCT FROM (payload ->> 'final_scheme')
                       THEN 'http2_endpoint_inconsistent'
                   WHEN payload ->> 'final_scheme' = 'http' THEN CASE
                       WHEN payload ->> 'http_protocol' IN ('HTTP/1.0', 'HTTP/1.1') AND payload ->> 'tls_alpn' = ''
                           THEN 'http_plaintext_not_applicable'
                       ELSE 'http2_protocol_alpn_inconsistent'
                   END
                   WHEN payload ->> 'http_protocol' = 'HTTP/2.0' AND payload ->> 'tls_alpn' = 'h2'
                       THEN 'http2_negotiated'
                   WHEN payload ->> 'http_protocol' IN ('HTTP/1.0', 'HTTP/1.1')
                        AND payload ->> 'tls_alpn' IN ('', 'http/1.1')
                       THEN 'http1_negotiated_h2_enabled'
                   WHEN payload ->> 'http_protocol' NOT IN ('HTTP/2.0', 'HTTP/1.0', 'HTTP/1.1')
                       THEN 'http2_protocol_unknown'
                   ELSE 'http2_protocol_alpn_inconsistent'
               END AS reason
        FROM evidence
    )
    INSERT INTO public.gfn_metric_entity_daily (
        metric_key, metric_version, fact_date, site_id, state, reason_code,
        source_observed_at, dimension_values, source_projection_versions, evaluated_at
    )
    SELECT target_metric_key, target_metric_version, target_date, site_id,
           CASE reason
               WHEN 'http2_negotiated' THEN 'positive'
               WHEN 'http1_negotiated_h2_enabled' THEN 'negative'
               WHEN 'http_plaintext_not_applicable' THEN 'not_applicable'
               WHEN 'http_state_stale' THEN 'stale'
               WHEN 'http_probe_failed' THEN 'probe_failed'
               WHEN 'http_not_probed' THEN 'not_probed'
               ELSE 'unknown'
           END,
           reason, observed_at,
           jsonb_build_object('site_country', to_jsonb(site_country), 'group_ids', to_jsonb(group_ids),
                              'nsfw', to_jsonb(nsfw), 'welfare', to_jsonb(welfare)),
           jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
               'gfn_site_daily', projection_version, 'gfn_site_target_daily', target_version,
               'gfn_site_target_protocol_daily', protocol_version)),
           transaction_timestamp()
    FROM reasons;

    GET DIAGNOSTICS entity_rows = ROW_COUNT;

    WITH registry AS (
        SELECT allowed_dimensions
        FROM public.gfn_metric_registry
        WHERE metric_key = target_metric_key AND metric_version = target_metric_version
    ), entities AS (
        SELECT * FROM public.gfn_metric_entity_daily
        WHERE metric_key = target_metric_key AND metric_version = target_metric_version
          AND fact_date = target_date
    ), memberships AS (
        SELECT entity.site_id, 'global'::text AS dimension_key, 'all'::text AS dimension_value
        FROM entities entity
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entity.site_id, 'site_country',
               COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(entity.dimension_values ->> 'site_country'), ''), 'unknown')
        FROM entities entity CROSS JOIN registry
        WHERE 'site_country' = ANY(registry.allowed_dimensions)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entity.site_id, 'nsfw',
               CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(entity.dimension_values -> 'nsfw') = 'boolean'
                    THEN entity.dimension_values ->> 'nsfw' ELSE 'unknown' END
        FROM entities entity CROSS JOIN registry
        WHERE 'nsfw' = ANY(registry.allowed_dimensions)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entity.site_id, 'welfare',
               CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(entity.dimension_values -> 'welfare') = 'boolean'
                    THEN entity.dimension_values ->> 'welfare' ELSE 'unknown' END
        FROM entities entity CROSS JOIN registry
        WHERE 'welfare' = ANY(registry.allowed_dimensions)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entity.site_id, 'group_id', member.value
        FROM entities entity CROSS JOIN registry
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(
            CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(entity.dimension_values -> 'group_ids') = 'array'
                 THEN entity.dimension_values -> 'group_ids' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
        ) member(value)
        WHERE 'group_id' = ANY(registry.allowed_dimensions)
          AND member.value ~ '^[0-9]+$'
    ), unique_memberships AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT site_id, dimension_key, dimension_value FROM memberships
    )
    INSERT INTO public.gfn_metric_daily (
        metric_key, metric_version, fact_date, dimension_key, dimension_value,
        population_count, eligible_count, not_applicable_count,
        positive_count, negative_count, stale_count, not_probed_count,
        probe_failed_count, unknown_count, computed_at
    )
    SELECT target_metric_key, target_metric_version, target_date,
           membership.dimension_key, membership.dimension_value,
           count(*)::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state <> 'not_applicable')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'not_applicable')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'positive')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'negative')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'stale')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'not_probed')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'probe_failed')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'unknown')::bigint,
           transaction_timestamp()
    FROM unique_memberships membership
    JOIN entities entity ON entity.site_id = membership.site_id
    GROUP BY membership.dimension_key, membership.dimension_value;

    INSERT INTO public.gfn_metric_daily (
        metric_key, metric_version, fact_date, dimension_key, dimension_value,
        population_count, eligible_count, not_applicable_count,
        positive_count, negative_count, stale_count, not_probed_count,
        probe_failed_count, unknown_count, computed_at
    ) VALUES (
        target_metric_key, target_metric_version, target_date, 'global', 'all',
        0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, transaction_timestamp()
    ) ON CONFLICT (metric_key, metric_version, fact_date, dimension_key, dimension_value)
      DO NOTHING;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.gfn_metric_daily daily
        WHERE daily.metric_key = target_metric_key
          AND daily.metric_version = target_metric_version
          AND daily.fact_date = target_date
          AND (
              daily.population_count <> daily.eligible_count + daily.not_applicable_count
              OR daily.eligible_count <> daily.positive_count + daily.negative_count
                  + daily.stale_count + daily.not_probed_count
                  + daily.probe_failed_count + daily.unknown_count
          )
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nav metric count invariant failed for %/% on %',
            target_metric_key, target_metric_version, target_date;
    END IF;

    RETURN entity_rows;
END;
$function$
functions.comment: 按独立切换起点重建指定 UTC 日 HTTP/2 v2 指标：仅可信新版最终 HTTPS 协议与 ALPN 一致时计正负例，明文不适用，保留原始证据时间、失败及未知；原子替换实体和去重单维计数，校验时间与数量守恒，返回实体数。

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gfn_project_metric_day(target_metric_key text, target_metric_version integer, target_date date)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    day_end timestamp with time zone := (target_date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
    freshness bigint;
    dimensions text[];
    source_protocol text;
    entity_rows bigint;
BEGIN
    SELECT freshness_seconds, allowed_dimensions
    INTO freshness, dimensions
    FROM public.gfn_metric_registry
    WHERE metric_key = target_metric_key
      AND metric_version = target_metric_version;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'unknown Nav metric %/%', target_metric_key, target_metric_version;
    END IF;
    IF target_metric_version <> 1
       OR target_metric_key NOT IN ('ipv6_adoption', 'tls13_adoption', 'security_txt_adoption') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nav metric evaluator is not compiled for %/%', target_metric_key, target_metric_version;
    END IF;

    source_protocol := CASE target_metric_key
        WHEN 'ipv6_adoption' THEN 'dns'
        WHEN 'tls13_adoption' THEN 'http'
        WHEN 'security_txt_adoption' THEN 'security_txt'
    END;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.gfn_site_daily site_fact
        LEFT JOIN public.gfn_site_target_daily target_fact
          ON target_fact.target_tracking_period_id = site_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id
         AND target_fact.fact_date = site_fact.fact_date
         AND target_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
        LEFT JOIN public.gfn_site_target_protocol_daily protocol_fact
          ON protocol_fact.target_tracking_period_id = site_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id
         AND protocol_fact.fact_date = site_fact.fact_date
         AND protocol_fact.protocol = source_protocol
         AND protocol_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
        WHERE site_fact.fact_date = target_date
          AND site_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
          AND site_fact.tracked_at_end
          AND CASE target_metric_key
              WHEN 'ipv6_adoption' THEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at > day_end
              WHEN 'tls13_adoption' THEN target_fact.tls_state_observed_at > day_end
              WHEN 'security_txt_adoption' THEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at > day_end
          END
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nav metric source evidence is after UTC day end for %/% on %',
            target_metric_key, target_metric_version, target_date;
    END IF;

    DELETE FROM public.gfn_metric_entity_daily
    WHERE metric_key = target_metric_key
      AND metric_version = target_metric_version
      AND fact_date = target_date;
    DELETE FROM public.gfn_metric_daily
    WHERE metric_key = target_metric_key
      AND metric_version = target_metric_version
      AND fact_date = target_date;

    INSERT INTO public.gfn_metric_entity_daily (
        metric_key, metric_version, fact_date, site_id, state, reason_code,
        source_observed_at, dimension_values, source_projection_versions,
        evaluated_at
    )
    SELECT target_metric_key,
           target_metric_version,
           target_date,
           site_fact.site_id,
           CASE
               WHEN site_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
               WHEN target_metric_key = 'ipv6_adoption' THEN CASE
                   WHEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND target_fact.dns_state_observed_at < day_end - make_interval(secs => freshness::double precision)
                       THEN 'stale'
                   WHEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL AND target_fact.dns_has_aaaa IS TRUE THEN 'positive'
                   WHEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL AND target_fact.dns_has_aaaa IS FALSE THEN 'negative'
                   WHEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'unknown'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count > 0 AND protocol_fact.success_count = 0
                       THEN 'probe_failed'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count = 0
                       THEN 'not_probed'
                   ELSE 'unknown'
               END
               WHEN target_metric_key = 'tls13_adoption' THEN CASE
                   WHEN target_fact.tls_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND target_fact.tls_state_observed_at < day_end - make_interval(secs => freshness::double precision)
                       THEN 'stale'
                   WHEN target_fact.tls_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND lower(COALESCE(target_fact.tls_handshake, '')) = 'not_tls'
                       THEN 'not_applicable'
                   WHEN target_fact.tls_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND upper(replace(COALESCE(target_fact.tls_version, ''), ' ', '')) = 'TLS1.3'
                       THEN 'positive'
                   WHEN target_fact.tls_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND NULLIF(btrim(target_fact.tls_version), '') IS NOT NULL
                       THEN 'negative'
                   WHEN target_fact.tls_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'unknown'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count > 0 AND protocol_fact.success_count = 0
                       THEN 'probe_failed'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count = 0
                       THEN 'not_probed'
                   ELSE 'unknown'
               END
               WHEN target_metric_key = 'security_txt_adoption' THEN CASE
                   WHEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at < day_end - make_interval(secs => freshness::double precision)
                       THEN 'stale'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND jsonb_typeof(protocol_fact.known_state -> 'exists') = 'boolean'
                        AND (protocol_fact.known_state ->> 'exists')::boolean
                       THEN 'positive'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND jsonb_typeof(protocol_fact.known_state -> 'exists') = 'boolean'
                        AND NOT (protocol_fact.known_state ->> 'exists')::boolean
                       THEN 'negative'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'unknown'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count > 0 AND protocol_fact.success_count = 0
                       THEN 'probe_failed'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count = 0
                       THEN 'not_probed'
                   ELSE 'unknown'
               END
           END,
           CASE
               WHEN site_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id IS NULL THEN 'primary_target_unknown'
               WHEN target_metric_key = 'ipv6_adoption' THEN CASE
                   WHEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND target_fact.dns_state_observed_at < day_end - make_interval(secs => freshness::double precision)
                       THEN 'dns_state_stale'
                   WHEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL AND target_fact.dns_has_aaaa IS TRUE THEN 'aaaa_present'
                   WHEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL AND target_fact.dns_has_aaaa IS FALSE THEN 'aaaa_absent'
                   WHEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'dns_metric_field_unknown'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count > 0 AND protocol_fact.success_count = 0
                       THEN 'dns_probe_failed'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count = 0
                       THEN 'dns_not_probed'
                   ELSE 'historical_probe_state_unknown'
               END
               WHEN target_metric_key = 'tls13_adoption' THEN CASE
                   WHEN target_fact.tls_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND target_fact.tls_state_observed_at < day_end - make_interval(secs => freshness::double precision)
                       THEN 'tls_state_stale'
                   WHEN target_fact.tls_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND lower(COALESCE(target_fact.tls_handshake, '')) = 'not_tls'
                       THEN 'target_not_tls'
                   WHEN target_fact.tls_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND upper(replace(COALESCE(target_fact.tls_version, ''), ' ', '')) = 'TLS1.3'
                       THEN 'tls13_negotiated'
                   WHEN target_fact.tls_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND NULLIF(btrim(target_fact.tls_version), '') IS NOT NULL
                       THEN 'tls_version_other'
                   WHEN target_fact.tls_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'tls_version_unknown'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count > 0 AND protocol_fact.success_count = 0
                       THEN 'tls_probe_failed'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count = 0
                       THEN 'tls_not_probed'
                   ELSE 'historical_probe_state_unknown'
               END
               WHEN target_metric_key = 'security_txt_adoption' THEN CASE
                   WHEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at < day_end - make_interval(secs => freshness::double precision)
                       THEN 'security_txt_state_stale'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND jsonb_typeof(protocol_fact.known_state -> 'exists') = 'boolean'
                        AND (protocol_fact.known_state ->> 'exists')::boolean
                       THEN 'security_txt_present'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND jsonb_typeof(protocol_fact.known_state -> 'exists') = 'boolean'
                        AND NOT (protocol_fact.known_state ->> 'exists')::boolean
                       THEN 'security_txt_absent'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'security_txt_field_unknown'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count > 0 AND protocol_fact.success_count = 0
                       THEN 'security_txt_probe_failed'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count = 0
                       THEN 'security_txt_not_probed'
                   ELSE 'historical_probe_state_unknown'
               END
           END,
           CASE target_metric_key
               WHEN 'ipv6_adoption' THEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at
               WHEN 'tls13_adoption' THEN target_fact.tls_state_observed_at
               WHEN 'security_txt_adoption' THEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at
           END,
           jsonb_build_object(
               'site_country', to_jsonb(site_fact.site_country),
               'group_ids', to_jsonb(site_fact.group_ids),
               'nsfw', to_jsonb(site_fact.nsfw),
               'welfare', to_jsonb(site_fact.welfare)
           ),
           jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
               'gfn_site_daily', site_fact.projection_version,
               'gfn_site_target_daily', target_fact.projection_version,
               'gfn_site_target_protocol_daily', protocol_fact.projection_version
           )),
           transaction_timestamp()
    FROM public.gfn_site_daily site_fact
    LEFT JOIN public.gfn_site_target_daily target_fact
      ON target_fact.target_tracking_period_id = site_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id
     AND target_fact.fact_date = site_fact.fact_date
     AND target_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
    LEFT JOIN public.gfn_site_target_protocol_daily protocol_fact
      ON protocol_fact.target_tracking_period_id = site_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id
     AND protocol_fact.fact_date = site_fact.fact_date
     AND protocol_fact.protocol = source_protocol
     AND protocol_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
    WHERE site_fact.fact_date = target_date
      AND site_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
      AND site_fact.tracked_at_end;

    GET DIAGNOSTICS entity_rows = ROW_COUNT;

    WITH registry AS (
        SELECT allowed_dimensions
        FROM public.gfn_metric_registry
        WHERE metric_key = target_metric_key
          AND metric_version = target_metric_version
    ), entities AS (
        SELECT *
        FROM public.gfn_metric_entity_daily
        WHERE metric_key = target_metric_key
          AND metric_version = target_metric_version
          AND fact_date = target_date
    ), memberships AS (
        SELECT entity.site_id, 'global'::text AS dimension_key, 'all'::text AS dimension_value
        FROM entities entity
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entity.site_id,
               'site_country',
               COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(entity.dimension_values ->> 'site_country'), ''), 'unknown')
        FROM entities entity CROSS JOIN registry
        WHERE 'site_country' = ANY(registry.allowed_dimensions)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entity.site_id,
               'nsfw',
               CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(entity.dimension_values -> 'nsfw') = 'boolean'
                    THEN entity.dimension_values ->> 'nsfw' ELSE 'unknown' END
        FROM entities entity CROSS JOIN registry
        WHERE 'nsfw' = ANY(registry.allowed_dimensions)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entity.site_id,
               'welfare',
               CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(entity.dimension_values -> 'welfare') = 'boolean'
                    THEN entity.dimension_values ->> 'welfare' ELSE 'unknown' END
        FROM entities entity CROSS JOIN registry
        WHERE 'welfare' = ANY(registry.allowed_dimensions)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entity.site_id, 'group_id', member.value
        FROM entities entity
        CROSS JOIN registry
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(
            CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(entity.dimension_values -> 'group_ids') = 'array'
                 THEN entity.dimension_values -> 'group_ids'
                 ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
        ) member(value)
        WHERE 'group_id' = ANY(registry.allowed_dimensions)
          AND member.value ~ '^[0-9]+$'
    ), unique_memberships AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT site_id, dimension_key, dimension_value
        FROM memberships
    )
    INSERT INTO public.gfn_metric_daily (
        metric_key, metric_version, fact_date, dimension_key, dimension_value,
        population_count, eligible_count, not_applicable_count,
        positive_count, negative_count, stale_count, not_probed_count,
        probe_failed_count, unknown_count, computed_at
    )
    SELECT target_metric_key,
           target_metric_version,
           target_date,
           membership.dimension_key,
           membership.dimension_value,
           count(*)::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state <> 'not_applicable')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'not_applicable')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'positive')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'negative')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'stale')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'not_probed')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'probe_failed')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'unknown')::bigint,
           transaction_timestamp()
    FROM unique_memberships membership
    JOIN entities entity ON entity.site_id = membership.site_id
    GROUP BY membership.dimension_key, membership.dimension_value;

    INSERT INTO public.gfn_metric_daily (
        metric_key, metric_version, fact_date, dimension_key, dimension_value,
        population_count, eligible_count, not_applicable_count,
        positive_count, negative_count, stale_count, not_probed_count,
        probe_failed_count, unknown_count, computed_at
    ) VALUES (
        target_metric_key, target_metric_version, target_date, 'global', 'all',
        0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, transaction_timestamp()
    ) ON CONFLICT (metric_key, metric_version, fact_date, dimension_key, dimension_value)
      DO NOTHING;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.gfn_metric_daily daily
        WHERE daily.metric_key = target_metric_key
          AND daily.metric_version = target_metric_version
          AND daily.fact_date = target_date
          AND (
              daily.population_count <> daily.eligible_count + daily.not_applicable_count
              OR daily.eligible_count <> daily.positive_count + daily.negative_count
                  + daily.stale_count + daily.not_probed_count
                  + daily.probe_failed_count + daily.unknown_count
          )
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nav metric count invariant failed for %/% on %',
            target_metric_key, target_metric_version, target_date;
    END IF;

    RETURN entity_rows;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gfn_project_metric_day_v2(target_metric_key text, target_metric_version integer, target_date date)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    day_end timestamp with time zone := (target_date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
    freshness bigint;
    source_protocol text;
    entity_rows bigint;
BEGIN
    SELECT freshness_seconds
    INTO freshness
    FROM public.gfn_metric_registry
    WHERE metric_key = target_metric_key
      AND metric_version = target_metric_version;

    IF NOT FOUND OR target_metric_version <> 2
       OR target_metric_key NOT IN ('ipv6_adoption', 'security_txt_adoption') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nav metric v2 evaluator is not compiled for %/%', target_metric_key, target_metric_version;
    END IF;

    source_protocol := CASE target_metric_key
        WHEN 'ipv6_adoption' THEN 'dns'
        WHEN 'security_txt_adoption' THEN 'security_txt'
    END;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.gfn_site_daily site_fact
        LEFT JOIN public.gfn_site_target_daily target_fact
          ON target_fact.target_tracking_period_id = site_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id
         AND target_fact.fact_date = site_fact.fact_date
         AND target_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
        LEFT JOIN public.gfn_site_target_protocol_daily protocol_fact
          ON protocol_fact.target_tracking_period_id = site_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id
         AND protocol_fact.fact_date = site_fact.fact_date
         AND protocol_fact.protocol = source_protocol
         AND protocol_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
        WHERE site_fact.fact_date = target_date
          AND site_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
          AND site_fact.tracked_at_end
          AND CASE target_metric_key
              WHEN 'ipv6_adoption' THEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at > day_end
              WHEN 'security_txt_adoption' THEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at > day_end
          END
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nav metric source evidence is after UTC day end for %/% on %',
            target_metric_key, target_metric_version, target_date;
    END IF;

    DELETE FROM public.gfn_metric_entity_daily
    WHERE metric_key = target_metric_key
      AND metric_version = target_metric_version
      AND fact_date = target_date;
    DELETE FROM public.gfn_metric_daily
    WHERE metric_key = target_metric_key
      AND metric_version = target_metric_version
      AND fact_date = target_date;

    INSERT INTO public.gfn_metric_entity_daily (
        metric_key, metric_version, fact_date, site_id, state, reason_code,
        source_observed_at, dimension_values, source_projection_versions,
        evaluated_at
    )
    SELECT target_metric_key,
           target_metric_version,
           target_date,
           site_fact.site_id,
           CASE
               WHEN site_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
               WHEN target_metric_key = 'ipv6_adoption' THEN CASE
                   WHEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND target_fact.dns_state_observed_at < day_end - make_interval(secs => freshness::double precision)
                       THEN 'stale'
                   WHEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND protocol_fact.known_state ->> 'aaaa_evidence' = 'present'
                       THEN 'positive'
                   WHEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND protocol_fact.known_state ->> 'aaaa_evidence' = 'confirmed_absent'
                       THEN 'negative'
                   WHEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'unknown'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count > 0 AND protocol_fact.success_count = 0
                       THEN 'probe_failed'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count = 0
                       THEN 'not_probed'
                   ELSE 'unknown'
               END
               WHEN target_metric_key = 'security_txt_adoption' THEN CASE
                   WHEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at < day_end - make_interval(secs => freshness::double precision)
                       THEN 'stale'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND protocol_fact.known_state ->> 'recognition' = 'present_valid'
                       THEN 'positive'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND protocol_fact.known_state ->> 'recognition' = 'absent'
                       THEN 'negative'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'unknown'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count > 0 AND protocol_fact.success_count = 0
                       THEN 'probe_failed'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count = 0
                       THEN 'not_probed'
                   ELSE 'unknown'
               END
           END,
           CASE
               WHEN site_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id IS NULL THEN 'primary_target_unknown'
               WHEN target_metric_key = 'ipv6_adoption' THEN CASE
                   WHEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND target_fact.dns_state_observed_at < day_end - make_interval(secs => freshness::double precision)
                       THEN 'dns_state_stale'
                   WHEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND protocol_fact.known_state ->> 'aaaa_evidence' = 'present'
                       THEN 'aaaa_present'
                   WHEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND protocol_fact.known_state ->> 'aaaa_evidence' = 'confirmed_absent'
                       THEN 'aaaa_confirmed_absent'
                   WHEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND protocol_fact.known_state ->> 'aaaa_evidence' = 'unavailable'
                       THEN 'aaaa_evidence_unavailable'
                   WHEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'aaaa_evidence_unknown'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count > 0 AND protocol_fact.success_count = 0
                       THEN 'dns_probe_failed'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count = 0
                       THEN 'dns_not_probed'
                   ELSE 'historical_probe_state_unknown'
               END
               WHEN target_metric_key = 'security_txt_adoption' THEN CASE
                   WHEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at < day_end - make_interval(secs => freshness::double precision)
                       THEN 'security_txt_state_stale'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND protocol_fact.known_state ->> 'recognition' = 'present_valid'
                       THEN 'security_txt_valid'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND protocol_fact.known_state ->> 'recognition' = 'absent'
                       THEN 'security_txt_absent'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND protocol_fact.known_state ->> 'recognition' = 'present_invalid'
                       THEN 'security_txt_invalid'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'security_txt_recognition_unknown'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count > 0 AND protocol_fact.success_count = 0
                       THEN 'security_txt_probe_failed'
                   WHEN protocol_fact.quality_basis = 'acquisition_ledger'
                        AND protocol_fact.attempted_count = 0
                       THEN 'security_txt_not_probed'
                   ELSE 'historical_probe_state_unknown'
               END
           END,
           CASE target_metric_key
               WHEN 'ipv6_adoption' THEN target_fact.dns_state_observed_at
               WHEN 'security_txt_adoption' THEN protocol_fact.known_state_observed_at
           END,
           jsonb_build_object(
               'site_country', to_jsonb(site_fact.site_country),
               'group_ids', to_jsonb(site_fact.group_ids),
               'nsfw', to_jsonb(site_fact.nsfw),
               'welfare', to_jsonb(site_fact.welfare)
           ),
           jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
               'gfn_site_daily', site_fact.projection_version,
               'gfn_site_target_daily', target_fact.projection_version,
               'gfn_site_target_protocol_daily', protocol_fact.projection_version
           )),
           transaction_timestamp()
    FROM public.gfn_site_daily site_fact
    LEFT JOIN public.gfn_site_target_daily target_fact
      ON target_fact.target_tracking_period_id = site_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id
     AND target_fact.fact_date = site_fact.fact_date
     AND target_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
    LEFT JOIN public.gfn_site_target_protocol_daily protocol_fact
      ON protocol_fact.target_tracking_period_id = site_fact.primary_target_tracking_period_id
     AND protocol_fact.fact_date = site_fact.fact_date
     AND protocol_fact.protocol = source_protocol
     AND protocol_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
    WHERE site_fact.fact_date = target_date
      AND site_fact.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
      AND site_fact.tracked_at_end;

    GET DIAGNOSTICS entity_rows = ROW_COUNT;

    WITH registry AS (
        SELECT allowed_dimensions
        FROM public.gfn_metric_registry
        WHERE metric_key = target_metric_key AND metric_version = target_metric_version
    ), entities AS (
        SELECT * FROM public.gfn_metric_entity_daily
        WHERE metric_key = target_metric_key AND metric_version = target_metric_version
          AND fact_date = target_date
    ), memberships AS (
        SELECT entity.site_id, 'global'::text AS dimension_key, 'all'::text AS dimension_value
        FROM entities entity
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entity.site_id, 'site_country',
               COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(entity.dimension_values ->> 'site_country'), ''), 'unknown')
        FROM entities entity CROSS JOIN registry
        WHERE 'site_country' = ANY(registry.allowed_dimensions)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entity.site_id, 'nsfw',
               CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(entity.dimension_values -> 'nsfw') = 'boolean'
                    THEN entity.dimension_values ->> 'nsfw' ELSE 'unknown' END
        FROM entities entity CROSS JOIN registry
        WHERE 'nsfw' = ANY(registry.allowed_dimensions)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entity.site_id, 'welfare',
               CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(entity.dimension_values -> 'welfare') = 'boolean'
                    THEN entity.dimension_values ->> 'welfare' ELSE 'unknown' END
        FROM entities entity CROSS JOIN registry
        WHERE 'welfare' = ANY(registry.allowed_dimensions)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entity.site_id, 'group_id', member.value
        FROM entities entity CROSS JOIN registry
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(
            CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(entity.dimension_values -> 'group_ids') = 'array'
                 THEN entity.dimension_values -> 'group_ids' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
        ) member(value)
        WHERE 'group_id' = ANY(registry.allowed_dimensions)
          AND member.value ~ '^[0-9]+$'
    ), unique_memberships AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT site_id, dimension_key, dimension_value FROM memberships
    )
    INSERT INTO public.gfn_metric_daily (
        metric_key, metric_version, fact_date, dimension_key, dimension_value,
        population_count, eligible_count, not_applicable_count,
        positive_count, negative_count, stale_count, not_probed_count,
        probe_failed_count, unknown_count, computed_at
    )
    SELECT target_metric_key, target_metric_version, target_date,
           membership.dimension_key, membership.dimension_value,
           count(*)::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state <> 'not_applicable')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'not_applicable')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'positive')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'negative')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'stale')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'not_probed')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'probe_failed')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity.state = 'unknown')::bigint,
           transaction_timestamp()
    FROM unique_memberships membership
    JOIN entities entity ON entity.site_id = membership.site_id
    GROUP BY membership.dimension_key, membership.dimension_value;

    INSERT INTO public.gfn_metric_daily (
        metric_key, metric_version, fact_date, dimension_key, dimension_value,
        population_count, eligible_count, not_applicable_count,
        positive_count, negative_count, stale_count, not_probed_count,
        probe_failed_count, unknown_count, computed_at
    ) VALUES (
        target_metric_key, target_metric_version, target_date, 'global', 'all',
        0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, transaction_timestamp()
    ) ON CONFLICT (metric_key, metric_version, fact_date, dimension_key, dimension_value)
      DO NOTHING;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.gfn_metric_daily daily
        WHERE daily.metric_key = target_metric_key
          AND daily.metric_version = target_metric_version
          AND daily.fact_date = target_date
          AND (
              daily.population_count <> daily.eligible_count + daily.not_applicable_count
              OR daily.eligible_count <> daily.positive_count + daily.negative_count
                  + daily.stale_count + daily.not_probed_count
                  + daily.probe_failed_count + daily.unknown_count
          )
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nav metric count invariant failed for %/% on %',
            target_metric_key, target_metric_version, target_date;
    END IF;

    RETURN entity_rows;
END;
